An '''exhibition''' was held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. It included an [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser battery]] and an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], and photos of a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]], an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]], [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', and an [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]].<ref name="Union 2">[[Union 2|''Union'' 2]]</ref>
